name: VADER
author: L'Cronx
summary: An orbit-based vector synth: an orbiter travels a shape (15 built in, 35 maths shapes, or your own SVG, OBJ, PNG or JPG) or one of 27 simulation modes across four corners. Each corner plays overtone generators, a ZYNTH voice or a WAV sample. Two timbres, arpeggiator, effects. Its screen runs on your phone: scan the QR code.
